pr_title: Feature: Set drag zone with debug toolbar area excluded
pr_body:
**Resolved / Related Issues**
Items resolved / related issues by this PR.
- Closes  #11592 

**Details**

Toolbar is useful when debugging. So I subtract the toolbar area before calling `AppWindowTitleBar.SetDragRectangles()` , only when the app is running in DEBUG mode. Now the area of toolbar won't be blocked any longer.

Method `GetDragZone()` is an algorithm for rectangle subtraction, and it is well suited to expand other use. For example, excluding a new area for new avatar control.

**Validation**
How did you test these changes?
- [x] Built and ran the app
- [ ] Tested the changes for accessibility

issue_context.title: Feature: Support "Select Element" feature in running application
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

![UFX8LALZ{N67(}TT CKG4(6](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62325494/223490620-1a70b4b1-61d2-41eb-b521-16239e06fb57.png)

When an app runs, we can see the in-app toolbar appear within the running application. It is useful when debugging and positioning bugs.

But because of the set of `AppWindowTitleBar.SetDragRectangles()`. The area of toolbar is blocked.

I hope when in debug mode, the area of toolbar can be made available for use.

### Requirements

- This proposal will support **Select Element** feature in running application (only available in DEBUG mode)

### Files Version

2.0.36.0

### Windows Version

Windows11 22H2 22621.1265

### Comments

_No response_
comments: This has been an issue ever since we moved to WinAppSdk, it doesn't really affect the app but it would be nice if there was a way to fix it.

> This has been an issue ever since we moved to WinAppSdk, it doesn't really affect the app but it would be nice if there was a way to fix it.

I thought we can simply use `#if DEBUG` and `SetDragRectangles` to exclude the specific area. Then this issue can be fixed.
That's a good idea, do you want to work on this?

> That's a good idea, do you want to work on this?

 Sure, let me try it out.
